job.title: [Post] ... looking for an experienced SAP Hybris (SAP Commerce Cloud) Technical Lead to ... CCV2

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Technical Lead | Senior Java, Spring & OCC API Expert
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, OCC REST APIs and headless commerce. Proven record designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations, CI/CD pipelines on CCv2, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and production support. Strong techno-functional consulting: requirements analysis, user stories, and stakeholder collaboration. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with AI-assisted development expertise.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Hybris Technical Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Ravinder Mortha’s vision to advance SAP Commerce Cloud capabilities on CCv2. With 5+ years leading SAP Hybris implementations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in Java, Spring, OCC APIs and end-to-end PIM/ERP integrations that align perfectly with this Technical Lead role.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership
bullets.text: Led design and delivery of backend and frontend features on SAP Commerce Cloud 2211, guiding junior developers and ensuring architectural best practices.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST services, built robust PIM-to-Hybris pipelines, and resolved complex ERP/MDM integration bottlenecks for global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, leveraging Docker and Kubernetes to achieve reliable, automated releases.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs, and production-ready solutions.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Ravinder Mortha’s focus on scaling SAP Commerce Cloud on the CCv2 platform aligns with my passion for building high-performance, headless e-commerce solutions. The company’s commitment to innovation and international collaboration offers the ideal environment for me to apply my SAP Hybris expertise, AI-assisted development experience, and techno-functional consulting skills to drive measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Ravinder Mortha accelerate SAP Commerce Cloud excellence, leveraging my proven SAP Hybris leadership and integration experience.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to discuss the Technical Lead role at Ravinder Mortha and how my API, integration and CCv2 expertise can add value. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Hybris Technical Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Hybris Technical Lead position. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to Ravinder Mortha’s success.

I look forward to the possibility of discussing my fit for the role.
